name: Psycho Cults
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Psychotic
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Psychotic Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Psychotic. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Protection Feat Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Protection Feat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Relentless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Relentless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Scout Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Enhanced Psychotic
specialRules.description: If this model has Psychotic, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Psychotic (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Self-Destruct
specialRules.description: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. If this model survives melee, after both sides have finished attacking, it is immediately killed, and the enemy unit takes X hits.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Shielded Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shielded. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Puncture
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Bane Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Bane when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: Predator
specialRules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Predator
specialRules.description: If this model has Predator, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Predator (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Protection Feat
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this unit takes wounds and most of its models have this rule, you may use this rule and roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
